svg.title: Headlines — achievements
svg.desc: Winner, Best Implementation at SENSORA 2.0 with SurgeGuard (team of three); IEEE-published research DOP-XML, presented at ACM IKDD at IISER Pune and IIIT Bangalore; patented ML-based application; Top 10 of 300 at HackBattle; Top 6 finalist at Celestia 2.0; CGPA 9.35; freelance client websites.
